description:
The entire production throughput path is exercised only against Mock/Dummy
connections. No test runs concurrent streams against a real engine, so real
concurrent-execution correctness is unverified:

- tests/unit/core/throughput/test_runner.py — stream_fn is a Mock; docstring
  states it does NOT test real multi-threaded timing.
- tests/integration/test_tpch_throughput_test.py, test_tpcds_throughput_test.py
  — real ThreadPoolExecutor but Mock DB; the TPC-DS file notes "can't easily
  test full execution without a real database".
- tests/integration/test_throughput_corrections.py — strongest (real threads +
  timing) but still mock connections.

What is therefore unverified today: result integrity under concurrency,
connection/session isolation between streams, that all N streams actually run
all queries against loaded data, TTT/Throughput@Size math on real timings, and
behavior under real contention. DuckDB is embedded, fast, and already a test
dependency -- there is no reason the happy path is not covered end-to-end.

This item is foundational: the wiring-defect fix, independent-sessions work,
result-handling changes, and pre-generation change all need a real-DB oracle
to prove they did not regress or silently no-op.

anti_patterns.dont: gate the fast test lane on these
anti_patterns.why: mark them integration/slow so pr fast-lane stays quick.

preserves.behavior: Existing mock-based unit tests remain (fast lane) — real-DB tests are additive and marked slow/integration.

prior_art.concept: tests/integration/test_throughput_corrections.py — closest existing harness (real threads); extend it to a real DuckDB fixture instead of mocks.
tests/integration/test_tpch_power_test.py / test_tpcds_power_test.py — existing real-DuckDB single-stream fixtures to reuse for schema+load setup.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/integration -k 'throughput and duckdb' -m integration -v
verifications.expected: N-stream runs pass against real DuckDB

work_units.summary: Build a real-DuckDB throughput fixture (SF small) with tables loaded once and reused across streams
TPC-H happy-path test: N streams each run 22 queries against real data, all succeed, throughput_at_size > 0
TPC-DS happy-path test: N streams run the permuted set against real data
Concurrency-correctness assertions: no cross-stream result bleed; per-stream query counts correct; streams_successful == N
